name: LISAA
description:
Want to study at France's leading School of Applied Arts?

LISAA School of Art and Design trains designers and managers in animation, video games, interior architecture, design, graphic design and fashion.

LISAA School of Art and Design has continued to retain its academic excellence for more than 30 years and is a leading destination for aspiring artists and designers.

The institution offers multiple programs at bachelorâ€™s and masterâ€™s levels in arts and design, including fashion design, interior architecture, graphic design, and animation.

Additionally, LISAA boasts partnerships with leading industry organisations and cultural institutions and offers students opportunities for internships and project collaborations.

Want to know more? Discover why LISAA School of Art & Design might be the place for you!

LISAA School of Art & Design was founded in 1986, with campuses located in Paris, Nantes, Rennes, Toulouse, and Strasbourg.

With a curriculum based on practical and creative learning, LISAA is widely recognised for its contributions to art and design education.

LISAA's campuses provide students with access to modern facilities and state-of-the-art resources.

Imagine light-filled studios and collaborative spaces like spacious design labs! The campuses feature spacious studios, workshops, and labs equipped with the latest technology for creative innovation.

Why LISAA School of Art & Design?

  • LISAA has an international student body, contributing to the institution's multicultural and global learning environment.
  • The institution boasts a faculty comprised of experienced professionals and industry experts.
  • LISAAâ€™s alumni and industry connections provide support and opportunities for graduates as they navigate their academic and professional journeys.

Student Life

Students enjoy a dynamic and creative environment at LISAA among artists and designers. Students take part in different extracurricular activities and attend workshops, exhibitions, and cultural events.

The institution also conducts guest lectures and provides networking opportunities for students.

Located in Paris, the LISAA School of Art & Design is close to design studios, museums, and galleries. There are many entertainment, dining, and recreational options, providing students with a fun and urban experience.
